Package in.co.rays.proj4.bean

Class BaseBean

java.lang.Object
in.co.rays.proj4.bean.BaseBean
All Implemented Interfaces:
DropDownListBean
Direct Known Subclasses:
CollegeBean, CourseBean, FacultyBean, MarksheetBean, RoleBean, StudentBean, SubjectBean, TimetableBean, UserBean
public abstract class BaseBean extends Object implements DropDownListBean
BaseBean is an abstract class that works as a common base for all bean classes in the project. It contains shared audit fields like id, createdBy, modifiedBy, createdDatetime and modifiedDatetime so that every bean class does not have to define these fields separately. It also implements DropDownListBean interface so any bean extending this class can be used in dropdown lists.

Nimish
